stem.text: An unstretched rubber cord is stretched by a force. The force $F$ is plotted against the extension $x$. $F$ is slowly increased from zero, causing the cord to extend along path P. $F$ is then reduced back to zero along path Q.

stem.alt: Graph of F against x, with F on the vertical axis and x on the horizontal axis, both starting at 0. Two curves labelled P and Q form a shaded region between them, with arrows showing the direction along each path.

stem.text: What is represented by the shaded area?

A.text: the elastic energy stored in the rubber cord

B.text: the energy that causes plastic deformation

D.text: the work done to extend the rubber cord
